summary: Lisata Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing merger agreement with Kuva Labs Inc. and its acquisition subsidiary. The amendment reduced the per-share cash consideration from $5.00 to $4.00 and modified the contingent value rights (CVRs) from one $1.00 milestone to two milestones totaling up to $3.00 per CVR. The CVRs are non-tradeable and tied to clinical trial milestones for LSTA1 in glioblastoma. The Original Merger Agreement was announced March 6, 2026; no board recommendation or advisor update is provided. The deal remains an all-cash acquisition plus CVRs. The reduction in upfront cash, offset by larger contingent payments, shifts risk to shareholders pending trial outcomes. Watch for stockholder vote and regulatory clearance timelines.
